scope: Independent runtime family fixed-temperature response; not a C200 state import or root result
transition_semantics: Twelve completed cycles at new Tc before first stopping check, including the final ten-cycle observation window; NOT twelve discarded settling cycles. The first two new-Tc cycles and transition endpoint are excluded from the earliest window. Original public periodicity and target precision remain mandatory.
failure_policy: Diagnose preserved error or failed original gates. Only this family's last fully verified complete packet may be considered for recovery; do not reset states or propagate failed packets.
storage_policy: Retain first intervention packet, all complete OPs, compact gates/contracts and current ten-cycle window. Retire only superseded raw prefix after successful sealing with an exact hashed plan. No live-run deletion.
